_meta.v3Note: The live source contains 904 species and 227 consolidated family namespaces. Counts are configuration, not code: changing them requires regenerating the model-free plan before proposal stages run.
_meta.generalTier2026_09_11: generalCount was 25 (5 per category), which the sealed ideal (action-corpus-ideal.md §17) sizes at 500 (100 per category); it carried no per-category reach against 1,135 family and 4,520 species briefs. Raised to 1000 (200 per category), the owner's upper bound, so the general tier is a real comparison set for the family and signature tiers. `version` moved 2 -> 3 because the plan's own corpusHash folds this number in, and a count change that did not move the hash would let a stale plan pass the runner's freshness check.
